color.note: Hostess borrows the calm of the Claude desktop app: a warm ivory ground, warm greys rather than cool ones, structure drawn with hairline borders instead of shadows or glass, and one clay accent used sparingly. Every text token's note names the grounds it is allowed on; each pair is checked in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-window
tokens.usage: Ivory. The window ground and the content area itself — most of the app is simply this. Ground for `ink-primary`, `ink-secondary` and `accent`.

tokens.name: surface-content
tokens.usage: White cards on the ivory ground: the editor, the .env table, a list group. Separated from the ground by `hairline`, never by a shadow. Ground for `ink-primary`, `ink-secondary`, `ink-tertiary` and every `code-*` token.

tokens.name: surface-sidebar
tokens.usage: The source list column: one warm step below the ground, with a `hairline` on its trailing edge. Ground for `ink-primary` and `ink-secondary`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, sheets, the menu bar panel body and the active segment pill. Ground for `ink-primary` and `ink-secondary`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells: the editor gutter, a code block, the segmented-control track, a disabled field. Ground for `ink-secondary` and `ink-tertiary`.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: The hover and pressed fill on rows, menu items and plain buttons, and the caret line in the editor — warm grey at 10%, the way the Claude app tints a hovered row. Decorative.

tokens.name: surface-menubar
tokens.usage: The menu bar panel. Nearly opaque; a `hairline` edge and `shadow-popover`. Ground for `ink-primary` and `ink-secondary`.

tokens.name: surface-scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the window behind a modal sheet. Never place text on it.

tokens.name: ink-primary
tokens.usage: Slate. Titles, labels, hostnames and key names. On `surface-window`, `surface-content`, `surface-sidebar`, `surface-raised` and `surface-menubar`.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Sublabels, paths, counts, shortcut hints. On `surface-window`, `surface-content`, `surface-sidebar`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, masked secrets, disabled labels, empty-state copy. On `surface-content` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an `accent` fill — white in Light, Slate in Dark, because the dark accent is the lighter Clay.

tokens.name: ink-on-status
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a filled `success`, `warning` or `danger` swatch.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The structural line of the whole app: around every card, along the sidebar's trailing edge, between rows, under the toolbar. Slate at 15%, 1px. Decorative — a control never relies on it alone.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: A firmer line where a shape must be found on its own: the border of a secondary button and of a text field. Decorative still; meaning comes from `border-control`.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: The outline of a control that has no fill and must still be found — the off state of a switch, an invalid or focused text field's ring. Holds 3:1 on `surface-content`, `surface-window` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px, following the control's own radius. Holds at least 3:1 on every surface it lands on.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Deep clay — the one emphasis colour, used sparingly: the primary button, links, the on state of a switch, the selected sidebar row's text and glyph. As text it holds 4.5:1 on `surface-window`, `surface-content` and `surface-sidebar`.

tokens.name: accent-bright
tokens.usage: Clay at full strength. Marks only, never text: the switch track when on, the status item badge, the app icon ground, a progress ring. White holds 3:1 on it.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Pointer-down and hover state of any `accent` fill.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis accent ground: the info banner, an active filter chip, a selected table row. Not the caret line in the editor — that is `surface-hover`, so it can never be confused with a removed diff line. Ground for `accent` and `ink-primary`.

tokens.name: control-track
tokens.usage: The off track of a switch and the empty part of a slider. Decorative: the off state is carried by the `border-control` outline and the knob position.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Applied, healthy, in sync, port free. Always with a word or an SF Symbol — never hue alone. As text on `surface-content`, `surface-window` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a success badge or banner. Ground for `success` and `ink-primary`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Drifted from disk, variable missing from .env.example, staging environment. As text on `surface-content`, `surface-window` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning badge or banner. Ground for `warning` and `ink-primary`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, production environment, a port held by an unknown process, a broken hosts line. As text on `surface-content`, `surface-window` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a danger badge, a confirmation sheet, or a production banner. Ground for `danger` and `ink-primary`.

tokens.name: env-local
tokens.usage: The Local / Development environment everywhere it is named: profile chip, menu bar row, editor header. Green — safe.

tokens.name: env-staging
tokens.usage: The Staging environment. Same scale as the status colours, so a colour never means two things.

tokens.name: env-production
tokens.usage: The Production environment. Always shown with the word `Production`, never colour alone.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comment lines in the hosts file and .env (`#`). On `surface-content`.

tokens.name: code-key
tokens.usage: Variable names in .env and hostnames in the hosts file. On `surface-content`.

tokens.name: code-value
tokens.usage: Values and quoted strings in .env. On `surface-content`.

tokens.name: code-ip
tokens.usage: IP addresses in the hosts file and numeric literals. On `surface-content`.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Ground of an added line in the .env diff. Ground for `ink-primary` and `code-key`.

tokens.name: diff-remove
tokens.usage: Ground of a removed line in the .env diff. Ground for `ink-primary` and `code-comment`.

type.note: The Claude pairing: a serif for titles and the few editorial moments, a quiet sans for the interface, a mono for anything a developer could paste into a terminal. Anthropic's own faces are named first with honest fallbacks — no font files ship with this system; where they are not installed, Georgia and the system sans render.

families.display: "Anthropic Serif", Georgia, "Times New Roman", Times, serif
families.mono: "Anthropic Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: text-large-title
styles.usage: Onboarding, the About window, the empty state of a pane. Serif at a moderate weight — never faux-bold.

styles.name: text-title
styles.usage: The title of a pane in the toolbar, a sheet title, a section heading in Settings.

styles.name: text-headline
styles.usage: The label of a toggle row, a table column header, the name in the menu bar header.

styles.name: text-body
styles.usage: The default. Buttons, menu items, list rows, field text — everything unless a rule below says otherwise.

styles.name: text-callout
styles.usage: Banner body, popover helper text, inspector detail.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Metadata under a row, keyboard shortcut hints, byte counts. Always in `ink-secondary` or `ink-tertiary`.

styles.name: text-menu-label
styles.usage: Group labels in the sidebar and the menu bar panel. Sentence case, `ink-secondary` — never uppercase; the Claude app does not shout.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: The hosts and .env editors, the diff view, log output.

styles.name: mono-strong
styles.usage: The key half of a key/value row, and the matched substring in a search result.

styles.name: mono-caption
styles.usage: File paths in breadcrumbs and subtitles, port numbers, PIDs, inline code chips.

spacing.note: A 4px rhythm with generous room — the Claude app breathes. `space-4` is the gap inside a row, `space-7` the padding of a card.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label; badge inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked caption lines; menu item vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside a chip or small button.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The default gap between controls in a row, and a list row's vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a list row, a menu bar row, a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Pane padding, gap between a label group and its control column.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a pane.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Sheet padding, empty-state inset.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Top inset of an empty state; gap between major blocks in Settings.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between the hero header of a pane and its first card.

radius.note: Claude-app radii: rounded but never bubbly. Controls and rows share one radius; only chips and switches are pills.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code chips, the selection highlight inside the editor, a keyboard-shortcut key.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, segmented controls, sidebar rows on hover and selection, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, banners, the editor, the active-profile card in the panel.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers, sheets and the menu bar panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The window corner as macOS draws it — kept as a token so the concentric maths still works.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Environment chips, status dots and the switch only.

shadow.note: Shadows are rare. Structure is drawn with `hairline`; a shadow appears only under something that opens over the window.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: The knob of a switch and the active segment pill. Nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Optional, under a card that sits on `surface-window`, in addition to its `hairline`. Barely there.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: The menu bar panel, popovers and modal sheets.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the app repeats. Controls are the Claude app's height; the panel is a fixed width so its rows never reflow.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inline buttons inside a table row.

tokens.name: control-height-md
tokens.usage: The default: push buttons, text fields, segments.

tokens.name: control-height-lg
tokens.usage: The default button in a sheet.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: A single-line list row in the sidebar or a table.

tokens.name: menubar-width
tokens.usage: Fixed width of the menu bar panel.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Default width of the source list; resizable between 200px and 320px.

tokens.name: pane-inset
tokens.usage: Padding of the content area, and the gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: gutter-width
tokens.usage: Line-number gutter in the hosts and .env editors.

tokens.name: hairline-width
tokens.usage: Every structural line.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring, drawn 2px outside the control.

opacity.note: Only two. A disabled control is dimmed, never recoloured.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Any disabled control, including its label and glyph.

tokens.name: opacity-inactive-window
tokens.usage: Toolbar glyphs and the sidebar selection when the window is not key.
